about_the_game:
"I want you to be mine. I want to trap you, to wrap you in a web. Every day you’ll wake up, and the only person you’ll see is me. The only person you’ll need is me."

The "Karamu Trilogy" is a series of three horror romance visual novels about a girl who tries to break up with her (obsessive) boyfriend who really doesn't want to break up. Playable in English and French.

Synopsis

"Two weeks ago, you sent your boyfriend a breakup text. Now, you're stuck in the middle of the forest with nothing but a broken bike, a cellphone with no reception, and your slightly creepy ex(?)-boyfriend for company. He wants to talk, and one thing is clear: he really doesn't want to break up. (He probably won't take no for an answer.)

He's hiding secrets, but you've got a few of your own... and it seems like your pasts are tangled in ways that you could never have imagined. As this bloodstained mess of a relationship approaches its conclusion, one question remains:

Which one of you is the monster?"

Features

🔪 ​Three games bundled into one neat package, with a total of 80k+ words (over 5 hours of playtime)!

🕸️ ​One extremely devoted and loyal male love interest who REALLY can't live without you.

🎙️ ​Voice acting (the first two games are fully voiced, while the third is partially voiced!)

🌐 ​Available in English and French! 

🏆 ​Unlockable achievements and CG/ending gallery!

📖 ​Different font options to customize your reading experience.
